title: Start in light
notes: mode when no theme is saved, preserve explicit dark/light preferences and
expose both controls in the public header. Recaptured the synthetic
dashboard in light mode for the landing, social preview and README
overview. The new public image URL avoids reusing a cached dark preview.
evidence: `pnpm run type-check`, focused ESLint and `pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.mts test/publicSiteRouting.test.ts test/publicDomainNavigation.test.tsx`. Browser checks verify light startup with a dark OS preference, dark/light persistence after reload and no horizontal overflow at 390px. These checks also passed against production after deploying runtime `e872ecf`. `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check-public-website.py https://insight.vexamail.com teleporte.es` passed. The new image returned HTTP 200 with a SHA-256 matching the committed capture; Vexa Mail remained HTTP 200. The prior public runtime is preserved.
